subject: MBX-1114: final decision in the policy-exception thread
body:
Hi, Nora Lindqvist from the compliance team here. What did we finally decide on the exception
request for two-factor policy? I need the outcome, who decided, and the date of the deciding
message.

If a later message corrects an earlier decision, the later one counts.

Regards, Nora Lindqvist -- compliance
